Ultimate Switch Testing Lab

A single-page HTML suite mimicking different types of web switch implementations. Ideal for scaling custom test automation abstractions like browser.switch('target').on().

Standard Switch Implementations
The real checkbox is hidden. Testing frameworks often throw "Element is not interceptable" errors unless clicking the sibling .slider label/span layer.
No native form controls. Uses JavaScript to handle state transitions. Automation needs to parse aria-checked rather than properties.
Standard HTML button control changing classes or attribute flags dynamically via JavaScript execution.
Unstyled baseline representation. Handled flawlessly out of the box by standard .click() or .check() commands.
Advanced Contexts & Restrictions
Validates if the framework cleanly intercepts disabled parameters and throws expected interaction errors safely.
Playwright pierces this natively. Selenium requires extracting the web component host shadow root context first.
Requires driving a context switch step (e.g., driver.switchTo().frame() or Playwright Frame Locators).
